Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit, before any margin (cost:350020).
Our forecast for this part shows a recorded change of +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We can accept your terms and await your order. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €438.21 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

reasons: Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Our management has frozen all price reductions until December …. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We have reviewed your should-cost estimate and volume forecast; however, as a matter of policy, we do not share internal cost breakdowns.
Should you require further price adjustments, we would need to explore longer contract durations.
Material accounts for about … of our cost; more detail we do not share.
